verdict.rationale: cubic's docs say every PR is scanned for logic errors, bugs and security vulnerabilities. Ultrareview adds a deeper multi-pass analysis, and a Datadog integration lets agents check findings against production logs. One community user reported more technical explanations than basic checks. However, the race-condition and edge-case parts of the story are never documented, and there is no independent evidence of real-bug catch rate versus style nits. Missing for 10: documented detection of race conditions and broken edge cases, independent or hands-on corroboration of bug-catching accuracy, evidence on precision versus style-nit noise.

support.subject: As a developer, the reviewer catches real bugs in my PR — logic errors, race conditions, broken edge cases — not just style nits

citations.quote: The AI automatically scans every pull request for a wide range of issues, including logic errors, style inconsistencies, and potential security vulnerabilities.
Spots bugs and improvements: Comments on bugs and improvements in pull requests
It runs a longer, multi-pass analysis using cubic's most capable review models
Now you can connect Datadog, and cubic agents will check whether your production logs confirm their findings.
